_doc: Rules for building_sets.py. Every STONE / DEEPSLATE block registered with block(...) gets a building set unless it is listed in exclude (ores, carved / framed patterns, blocks that already are bricks, non-stone). Composite blocks (facing / pillar) and the capped stones (*_capped_*) are skipped automatically. include: extra blocks to force in. Slabs, stairs and walls of a block with tones or stages use its DEFAULT state (first tone / stage 0) textures, random variants kept.
